notes.title: Balancing (And bug fixing)
notes.content:
Many bosses have had a difficulty nerf (mostly health related)

Wave no longer incorrectly plays the damage sound on start

Gloom now correctly fades in

Wave & Eclipse now have achievements

notes.title: QOL Mini-update
notes.content: You can now see what character you have equipped, locked characters are more obvious, and there's now a popup to show that there's more bosses.

notes.title: Deimos + Voidsent
notes.content:
Added new character "Deimos"

Added new boss "Voidsent"

Nerfed "Listener" a small amount

Added “Bolt” character

“Damage Dealt” stat will no longer go down when healing boss

Added “Damage pack damage dealt”, “drain damage dealt”, and “Boss health healed” stats

Added “Listener” boss

Added a few new tips

Added “Error” character

Added "Alter"

Deaths are now tracked & visible in the logbook

Bullseye now acts internally differently and will now work more consistently on different frame rates

Bullseye's speed may be altered from this change

Added “Fall” attack
Rain: Left hail => Down Fall
Psionic: Ability changed from “Damage is not dealt over time. Damage packs are twice as common and deal twice as much damage. Can teleport every 3 seconds.” to “3x drain rate. All attacks are sent instantly. Projectiles are doubled. Can teleport every 3 seconds.” Health: 4 => 3. Speed: 35 => 30
Fixed a bug where you could unlock a currently unused character
Chaos now displays the correct names of bullets added

Added Watcher boss
Added spotlight attack
Removed 2 Smoke Screens from Spectral
Added 1 spotlight to Spectral
Added Smoke Screen to Chaos menu
Bullseye’s stats now correctly display 7 Health

- Added Spectral boss
- Some hit sound effects were changed
- (Hopefully) fixed a bug where resolution was not 1920x1080p causing many UI elements to break
Fixed a bug where Corrupt would be invisible

notes.title: 0.1 Update notes
notes.content:
Added 4 new characters
Added a secret boss

notes.title: Update 0.1
notes.content:
Added 4 new characters to unlock along with steam achievements for them!

Unlock Nova, Decay, Angel, and Psionic now!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636371/27ae774d44a19d1daefdbe8314e6721360adc644.png"]

There's also a new hidden boss, Decay, located somewhere on the main menu! Defeat it to unlock the character Decay.
